svg.text: TOP 102 HOLE TABLE (datum: auger axis, ±0.2 unless noted)
Pod 106 to top, and its seams
Weld nuts H14 to base; studs M6 to back
1. Shell, door, pod: laser cut from -101 DXF, then brake. Bend the wrap on a 600 x 600 square gauge: diagonals equal within 2.
2. Lay the top face down on a flat table, fit the shell, tack 8 places, then weld W1 in 100 mm runs skipping round. Top flat 1.0 after welding.
3. Weld the backing plate 107 before drilling D1-D5 through both: match drill the 4 x Ø13 and the Ø60 from the top.
4. Door gasket FDA silicone on the return flanges (P1-444). Earth stud M6 on the back wall at the gland plate, bonded to the door.
5. Cable glands (P1-446) in the back wall: M25 supply, 2 x M20 (foot switch, spare), see -101.
